01 / FIRST IMPRESSIONS

Three posts. One clear story.

Introduce the idea, invite the people who can bring it to life, and make the experience easy to understand. Typography leads until actual hosts approve their photographs.

01 / Meet Qualia

Read caption + download

Miami is full of people who know something worth sharing. Qualia is being built around that idea: one host, one guest, and time to learn something personal. We’re putting together our first collection in Miami and Miami Beach. Follow along as we meet the people who will bring it to life.

02 / Invite the first hosts

Read caption + download

Already teach or share your work one-on-one in Miami or Miami Beach? We’re welcoming our first 30 Founding Hosts. Listing is free, and we’ll help write your experience page for you to approve. Eligible founders get 0% Qualia commission on their first 3 eligible paid bookings or first 3 calendar months, whichever comes first; processing fees still apply. The ongoing founding rate is 12.5%. Applications and listings are reviewed. Apply through the link in our profile, or say hello to Axel at axel@bookqualia.com.

03 / Explain the experience

Read caption + download

When our first reviewed experiences are ready, you’ll be able to find something that interests you, request a time and hear back from the host. Pay after your request is accepted, then meet for a one-on-one experience. Hosts submit their listing for review, with a consultation when needed, before publication. We’re currently building that first Miami collection. Follow along, or apply to host at bookqualia.com.

04 / THE NEXT REAL THING

Let people meet the person building it.

The next post should be Axel on camera, in his own words. Then the first real host: their face, their tools and a detail only they would notice.

Suggested founder opening: “I’m Axel, and I’m building Qualia here in Miami. I want it to be easier to spend time with people who really know their craft.”

Review the full platform plan before account setup. No profile, post or paid promotion has been published by preparing this kit.

WORK IN CLEAR STEPS

  1. Instagram + Facebook foundation. Owner access, matching identity, contact details and connected accounts.
  2. First three posts. Check the live crop, caption, website link and mobile profile.
  3. LinkedIn Company Page. A credible founder and partner presence.
  4. Yelp eligibility. Verify the marketplace model and the actual credit terms before creating or paying for anything.
  5. First host stories. Permission, specific details, real approved experiences.
The mailbox is for business correspondence. It is not a customer-facing Qualia venue. The social presence will reflect that.
